stem.text: Redox reactions are common in the chemistry of Group 17.

B.text: $\text{Cl}_2$ will oxidise $\text{Br}^{-}$ ions but not $\text{I}^{-}$ ions.

C.text: $\text{F}_2$ is the weakest oxidising agent out of $\text{F}_2$, $\text{Cl}_2$, $\text{Br}_2$ and $\text{I}_2$.

D.text: $\text{I}^{-}$ ions are the weakest reducing agent out of $\text{F}^{-}$, $\text{Cl}^{-}$, $\text{Br}^{-}$ and $\text{I}^{-}$.
